name: Osteoclast and macrophage development via CSF1 signaling
rationale: Members cover M-CSF/CSF1 and related interleukin receptor signaling driving macrophage proliferation/fusion and osteoclast differentiation and bone resorption; the CSF1 signaling plus osteoclast/bone-resorption combination separates it from confusables focused on DAP12 fusion or monocyte/dendritic differentiation.

name: Platelet activation via agonist G-protein-coupled receptors
rationale: All members concern platelet activation, aggregation and coagulation; the ADP P2Y, thrombin PAR, thromboxane and prostacyclin receptor members distinguish it from confusables centred on integrin/Rap1 signalling or collagen/GPIb adhesion.

name: Planar cell polarity driving convergent extension
rationale: Members are PCP establishment and non-canonical Wnt/PCP signalling plus convergent extension and neural plate morphogenesis; convergent extension in axis elongation/organogenesis separates it from confusables on axial mesoderm patterning or WNT5A receptor internalization.

core: Adenylate cyclase inhibition by G proteins
name: Adenylate cyclase inhibition via alpha-2 adrenoceptors
rationale: Members describe Gi/Gz-mediated inhibition of adenylate cyclase in cAMP-coupled GPCR signalling; the alpha-2 adrenergic receptor route distinguishes it from confusables on muscarinic/serotonin inhibition, catecholamine secretion control or cAMP/PKA activation.

core: Regulation of NK and T cell cytotoxicity
name: NK and T cell cytotoxicity regulation via MHC class Ib
rationale: Members are positive and negative regulation of NK and T cell cytotoxicity and NK receptor activation at lymphoid/non-lymphoid interfaces; MHC class Ib presentation and receptor-driven regulation distinguish it from confusables on granzyme killing, KIR clusters or T cell proliferation.

name: Embryonic craniofacial and limb morphogenesis
rationale: Members are face, palate, nose, neuro/viscerocranium and fore/hindlimb and digit morphogenesis with mesenchymal development; the limb and palate members separate it from confusables on pharyngeal-derived glands and ear or on cranial ossification.

name: Matrix adhesion signaling in fibroblast migration
rationale: Members cover focal adhesion assembly, fibronectin matrix and integrin production, SRF-driven cytoskeletal remodeling and fibroblast migration; fibroblast migration and fibronectin matrix distinguish it from confusables on syndecan/integrin surface interactions, stress fibres or EMT.

name: Skeletal muscle differentiation restraint and disuse atrophy
rationale: Members are negative regulation of myoblast/myotube differentiation, satellite cell maintenance and inactivity-driven atrophy with SCF-ubiquitin degradation; this inhibitory/atrophy direction distinguishes it from confusables on positive myogenesis, hypertrophy or contraction.

name: Recombination-dependent telomere maintenance via break-induced replication
rationale: Members cover telomere maintenance by recombination, t-circles, D-loop disassembly, telomere capping and break-induced replication; break-induced replication and recombination intermediate resolution distinguish it from confusables on general DNA repair or telomere C-strand synthesis.

name: cAMP-dependent protein kinase A activation
rationale: Members span cAMP synthesis, forskolin response, GPCR-cyclic nucleotide signalling and PKA activation; PKA activation and exocytosis inhibition distinguish it from confusables centred on CREB phosphorylation, PDE activity or adenylate cyclase inhibition.

name: ER–Golgi vesicle targeting with COPI retrograde transport
rationale: Members concern vesicle targeting between ER and Golgi and COPI vesicle budding for Golgi-to-ER retrieval; COPI retrograde traffic distinguishes it from confusables on COPII export, vesicle tethering or ER protein insertion.

name: Kidney development with nephron tubule patterning
rationale: Members are nephric duct, ureteric bud and nephron development across pro-, meso- and metanephros; nephron tubule segment patterning and differentiation distinguish it from confusables focused on ureteric bud induction or kidney size.

name: Endocytic receptor recycling to the plasma membrane
rationale: Members cover endocytosis, endosome organization, endosome-to-plasma-membrane and Golgi-to-plasma-membrane delivery and receptor recycling; recycling to the surface distinguishes it from confusables on endosome-to-Golgi retrograde, constitutive secretion or membrane tubulation.

name: Transcriptional control of myeloid progenitor differentiation
rationale: Members are myeloid progenitor programmes, RUNX1/VENTX/granulopoiesis transcriptional regulation and negative regulation of monocyte, macrophage and granulocyte differentiation; transcriptional and restraining control distinguishes it from confusables on positive lineage differentiation and mature monocyte trafficking.

name: RAF–ERK cascade activation and feedback inactivation
rationale: Members cover RAF/MAP2K/MAPK activation including oncogenic RAF, RAS and MAPK mutants, RSK activation, and ERK dephosphorylation/negative feedback; RAF-level activation and ERK feedback distinguish it from confusables on SOS/RAS activation or RAS GAP regulation.

name: Vitamin metabolism with vitamin K-dependent carboxylation
rationale: Members are vitamin K, C and E metabolism and response, including gamma-carboxylation of protein precursors; vitamin K-dependent gamma-carboxylation and ascorbate metabolism distinguish it from confusables on vitamin D, vitamin E/ubiquinol or oxygen transport.

core: Dendritic cell chemokine and cytokine production
name: cGAS–STING-driven dendritic cell chemokine production
rationale: Members regulate dendritic cell cytokine and CCL5/STAT6 chemokine production together with cGAMP import and positive cGAS–STING signalling; this distinguishes it from confusables on macrophage chemokines, Th1 priming, interferon-beta control or TLR7–9 signalling.

core: Noncoding RNA modification and small RNP biogenesis
name: Noncoding RNA methylation and small RNP biogenesis
rationale: Members cover rRNA, tRNA and snRNA methylation, cap hypermethylation, snRNP/snoRNP assembly and snRNA/scaRNA trafficking; methylation (rather than pseudouridylation) and snRNP biogenesis distinguish it from confusables.

core: Post-transcriptional mRNA stability and translation control
name: mRNA stability and translation control via stress granules
rationale: Members cover RNA-binding protein control of mRNA stability and translation (HuR, AUF1, IGF2BPs, L13a) with stress granule assembly, PKR and arsenite response; stress granule and translational silencing members distinguish it from confusables on ARE-mediated decay and decapping.

name: Chondrocyte differentiation and joint cartilage morphogenesis
rationale: Members are chondrocyte proliferation, differentiation, hypertrophy, condensation and growth-plate development plus embryonic joint morphogenesis; joint morphogenesis and condensation distinguish it from confusables on ossification, tendon or articular cartilage homeostasis.

name: Insulin secretion control in pancreatic beta cells
rationale: Members cover nutrient, incretin, fatty-acid, neural and KATP-channel regulation of insulin secretion plus insulin processing and islet hormone secretion; the beta-cell secretory side distinguishes it from confusables on insulin receptor signalling and GLUT4 translocation.

name: Ubiquitin–proteasome degradation with deubiquitinase chain editing
rationale: Members cover ubiquitin chain synthesis by linkage type, multiple deubiquitinase families, proteasome assembly and degradation regulation; deubiquitination and chain-type editing distinguish it from confusables on ERAD/autophagy quality control or neddylation.

name: Golgi organization and COPI–Rab vesicle traffic
rationale: Members cover Golgi structure (ribbon, disassembly, reassembly), COPI and intra-Golgi/Golgi-to-ER traffic, vesicle tethering and Rab/ARF GTPase regulation; Golgi structure plus COPI and Rab control distinguish it from confusables on TGN-to-lysosome traffic or COPII export.

name: Proline-centred amino acid metabolism
rationale: Members are general alpha/L-amino acid metabolism terms plus glutamine-family and proline biosynthesis and catabolism; proline distinguishes it from confusables on serine/glycine, glyoxylate or organic acid metabolism.

name: Retinoid metabolism and retinoic acid biosynthesis
rationale: Members cover retinol, retinal and retinoic acid metabolism and transport with terpenoid metabolism; retinoic acid biosynthesis distinguishes it from the visual retinoid cycle and from vitamin D or retinoic acid response confusables.

name: Telomere capping and recombination control
rationale: Members are telomere capping, protection from end joining, telomere packaging and protein localization, and control of recombination and telomerase at telomeres; end protection distinguishes it from confusables on telomere replication, D-loop/t-circle processing or telomerase extension.

name: Energy and redox cofactor interconversion
rationale: Members cover adenine/guanine nucleotide phosphorylation and mitochondrial ADP/ATP transport, phosphocreatine, and NAD/NADP synthesis, salvage and transport; this cofactor interconversion distinguishes it from confusables on apoptosis, nucleotide biosynthesis regulation or PRPP synthesis.

name: Telomere maintenance including telomerase Cajal body trafficking
rationale: Members span telomerase extension, C-strand synthesis, recombination-based maintenance, capping and telomeric chromatin, plus scaRNA/telomerase RNA Cajal body localization; the telomere focus and Cajal body trafficking distinguish it from broad DNA repair and senescence confusables.

core: Regulation of TLR-driven inflammatory cytokine production
name: TLR-driven inflammatory cytokine control with NLRP inflammasomes
rationale: Members cover bacterial ligand detection and positive/negative regulation of TLR2/3/4 signalling and inflammatory cytokines, with NLRP1/NLRP3 inflammasome IL-1 processing; NLRP inflammasomes with LPS/lipopeptide sensing distinguish it from confusables on pyroptosis/non-canonical inflammasomes or TRIF/MyD88 signalling.

name: Canonical Wnt signaling via AXIN destruction-complex stability
rationale: Members concern beta-catenin/TCF signalling and the AXIN/APC destruction complex, including AXIN degradation, stabilization and mutants; AXIN stability distinguishes it from confusables on DVL activation, FZD ubiquitination or target gene repression.
